I have farmed this land for many years, and for this small beans plot, I will do what has always worked for my family. Beans do not need chemical fertilizer like maize does, and I cannot afford to waste money on costly inputs when I have four and a half other hectares to think about. I will plant seeds I saved from last season's harvest, and my children and I will do the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves since the plot is not too big. I will buy some local insecticide to spray for the pod borers that always trouble our beans, but I will not irrigate because we depend on the rains here in the North Central.
